title: 用队列实现栈
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: One complete static Chinese algorithm explanation image for Bamboo Copter's dark desktop app. The user finds the old animation abstract; make the algorithm concrete and understandable on this single image.
Style: refined modern editorial educational infographic, flat precise diagrams, crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, balanced whitespace, readable labels. Landscape around 3:2. Deep charcoal background #171b20, warm white text, muted grey secondary text, restrained mint and amber accents. Main algorithm diagram occupies most of the canvas. Thin accurate arrows, small clean step numbers, distinguish indexes from values. No glossy 3D, mascot, decorative illustration, dashboard widgets, fake app window, play buttons, watermarks or full solution code. No excessive nested cards or huge empty areas. Use visual steps connected in reading order. ALL examples, indexes, formulas and Chinese labels below must be accurate and readable. Render only the specified content, with short explanatory Chinese labels; do not invent additional numerical examples. Main title top left, input directly underneath, 3-4 visual sections, and a compact complexity footer. The result should be visible immediately and the intermediate steps must explain how it was obtained.
Title: "225  用队列实现栈". Subtitle: "两个列表按队列使用，让最新元素站在队头". This is LeetCode225 two-queue implementation (push-cost method), NOT two stacks implementing a queue. A list may model a queue, but only append at back and remove/peek at front.
One complete explanatory image. Main diagram below title is four sequential steps left-to-right in a spacious 2x2 grid. Show BOTH queues Q1/Q2 in every state as horizontal trays of numbered cells. ALL trays: left is "队头", right is "队尾"; small legend. Q1 active queue mint, Q2 helper amber. Empty queue [] shown explicitly. FIFO arrows are never misleading. Reading order is ① top-left,② top-right,③ bottom-left,④ bottom-right. Connect step cards via subtle short arrows only in reading order.
Example summary near title: "push(1) → push(2) → top()=2 → pop()=2 → empty()=false".
Step① "压入新元素 2": initial after push(1): Q1=[1], Q2=[]; next snapshot Q1=[1],Q2=[2]. Caption "先把 2 加入辅助队列 Q2". Do not label push2 finished before moving old items.
Step② "搬移旧元素": a clear horizontal mini diagram with Q1=[1] above and Q2=[2] below, show transfer of 1 from Q1 FRONT into Q2 BACK, resulting Q1=[],Q2=[2,1]. The transfer arrow must arrive at cell1 at RIGHT/back, never into cell2. Label "从 Q1 队头取出，加入 Q2 队尾". Prefer clean before/after states with arrow between labels rather than complicated loop.
Step③ "交换两队列的角色": show resulting Q1=[2,1],Q2=[] after swapping references/roles, not reversing physical sequence. Mark queue head=2 with mint. Caption "新 Q1 的队头，就是栈顶". Tiny note "只交换引用，不倒转元素".
Step④ "查看与弹出": top()=2 (does not change Q1=[2,1]); pop()=2 then Q1=[1],Q2=[], empty()=false. Show two small exact rows and mark removal of FRONT2; do not popfromtail. Small emphasized result "后进的 2，先出".
An unobtrusive rules line: "只用队尾入队、队头出队/查看；不用列表下标或尾部删除".
Footer exact "push: O(n)    pop / top / empty: O(1)    辅助空间: O(n)" and "n 为栈内元素数；队列基本操作按 O(1) 计". This complexity refers to chosen push-cost method. No full code, no additional examples or bogus O1push. Keep Chinese text large readable; do not crowd. Landscape 1536×1024 if possible.
edits: Edit the attached Chinese LeetCode225 two-queue stack infographic. Preserve all layout, colors, numbers, textual content and all four before/after queue states exactly. One correction only: inside upper-right step2 "搬移旧元素", the amber dashed transfer arrow currently ends at the FAR RIGHT empty cell of Q2. It must instead END AT THE SECOND CELL of Q2, the immediately next slot to the right of the existing value2 (around x=970,y=433 on1536x1024). Queue append puts1 immediately AFTER2, not into last capacity cell. Keep arrow origin at Q1's cell1 (x~915,y~365); make a short smooth amber dashed right-down curve arriving downward at Q2's second cell with an amber arrowhead at its upper border. Reposition the tiny "取出1 / 加入队尾" label to the right of this short arrow so it remains fully readable and does not overlap the curve. Resulting right-hand state Q2=[2,1] remains unchanged. All other elements invariant.

review.example: 已核对官网示例 push(1), push(2), top()=2, pop()=2, empty()=false; 与弹出后的 Q1=[1] 相符.
review.steps: 实际最终 PNG 逐步检查: Q1=[1]/Q2=[] -> Q1=[1]/Q2=[2] -> Q1=[]/Q2=[2,1] -> 交换引用后 Q1=[2,1]/Q2=[]; top 不改变队列, pop 从队头删除2. 首图搬移箭头落点不精确, 已用官方 ImageGen 编辑为紧随2的第二格, 复查通过.
review.complexity: 图片和文本均为 push O(n), pop/top/empty O(1), 辅助空间 O(n), n 为栈内元素数, 基本队列操作 O(1); 说明区注明 ArrayDeque 入队摊还 O(1), 不将数组列表头删当 O(1).
review.text: 查看项目实际1536x1024 PNG原图, 225题号、中文四步、Q1/Q2、队头队尾、1/2以及false清楚, 后进先出的结果、交换引用规则及复杂度均可读.
